name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Ellis' grade is higher than both the class with Iris and the member of the Robotics club.
Ames' grade is immediately below the member of the Robotics club.
85% goes with at least one of Ames, Kira, or Chess.
The member of the Rowing club's grade is at least 10% more than the class with Iris.
